answer: The help center doesn't mention a form called NW-LRL-1, so I can't say what it's for. The forms the articles do describe are NW-LPA-1 (the lender payoff authorization, which lets us request a payoff letter from your lender for a loan; allow 2 business days), NW-LSE-1 (for selling a car you lease), and NW-ODO-2 (the odometer disclosure statement, which replaced NW-ODO-1 on February 1, 2026). Please contact a store to ask about NW-LRL-1.
